source: 外研社版(新标准)必修第二册 Unit 3 同主题完形(塑料袋做的球/我的第一节太极课/校运动会/我的第一次马拉松/跟着App跑步/从滑冰到冰球)。用词限 U3/初中/常见词,答案唯一,与阅读关不撞文章。答案位稍后打散。

passages.title: A Ball Made of Plastic Bags
passages.text: When Tiago was a boy, his family was poor and could not (1)____ a real football. That did not stop him. He made his own ball out of old (2)____ bags tied tightly together. Tiago was small, but he was quick, and he soon learned how to pass and (7)____ better than older boys. People in the town began to say that he was (8)____ enough to join a real club one day. 学会传球与 defend 防守,符合足球语境。
good enough to join「好到足以加入」。
梦想成真后成为当地 champion 冠军。

passages.title: My First Tai Chi Class

passages.title: School Sports Day
passages.text: Our school holds a sports day every spring, and this year I decided to (1)____ in the 800 metres. I had never been a fast runner, so I knew I had to (2)____ hard. passages.title: My First Marathon
passages.text: I had jogged for fun for years, but I had never run a (1)____ until last autumn. When I signed up, friends warned me that 42 kilometres was a long (2)____ for a beginner. passages.title: Running with an App
passages.text: A few years ago I did almost no exercise. Then a friend told me about a running (1)____ called Running Power. passages.title: From Skating to Ice Hockey
